sentences.en: Immediately after it caught fire, the chemical factory blew up.
sentences.zh: 它一着火就立刻爆炸了这家化工厂。

sentences.en: The building you see over there is an auto factory.
sentences.zh: 那边那栋建筑是一家汽车制造工厂。

sentences.en: The river is polluted by waste from houses and factories.
sentences.zh: 这条河被房屋和工厂排放的废物污染了。
